thread:
rowan: Quick sync following the RDI-4021 postmortem. We promised durable test artifacts and clear owners so we don't re-hit the fallback+tokenization regression. Need concrete tickets + dates.
meera: I'll take the deterministic repro + prompt corpus. Plan: a tiny "replay" suite that records inputs + model variant + seed and produces a reproducible hash. Will live under `suites/regression/replay_fallback_hash.json`. Target PR by Thu.
carlos: I'll own the deployment gate and monthly smoke automation. Proposal: two gates: (1) pre-deploy quick smoke (<=30s), (2) post-deploy regression scorecard run (5m) that blocks rollouts if thresholds hit. I'll also add a monthly automated chaos run.
rowan: Good. We also need the load/chaos scenario that triggers fallback under contention. Prefer to use Artillery for the spike test so we can easily run it from CI. Can you take that, @carlos?
carlos: Yup. Artillery shape: steady 220 rps for 90s, then 45s spike to 850 rps while toggling a node drain at +30s into the spike. I'll include abort criteria: 1) stop-seq regression >0.4% or 2) top-k drift >6% (30m window). Example snippet I will include: ```yaml
config:
  target: "${GEN_URL}"
  phases:
    - duration: 90
      arrivalRate: 220
    - duration: 45
      arrivalRate: 850
scenarios:
  - flow:
    - post:
        url: "/v1/generate"
        json: { "prompt": "role:user\\ncontent: test spike" }
```
meera: For the replay suite I'll include a small set of prefixes that historically exercised the fallback path and a lightweight verifier that checks role-token alignment and stop-seq completeness. The verifier will emit a short repro id: `repro:<sha1>` so triage can fetch the exact inputs.
rowan: Who will wire alerts into the eval dashboard? We want an automatic signal when the regression scorecard delta exceeds acceptable bounds and a quiet channel to surface these to the on-call.
meera: I'll add the metric wiring: scorecard.delta (0-1) and topk.shift_pct. Alert when scorecard.delta > 0.02 or topk.shift_pct > 5. Will also add a small Grafana panel with a direct link back to the repro bundle.
carlos: For CI: `ci-eval/regression-smoke` (fast) runs pre-merge, `ci-eval/regression-postdeploy` runs as part of canary and returns a JSON scorecard. If postdeploy fails, the deploy should auto-roll back. I'll add a lightweight harness that fails fast on token-truncation.
rowan: Rotation for triage: let's avoid doubling. Suggest `regression-duty` schedule with 2-person overlap: eng-ml weekdays 09:00-18:00, eng-runtime nights/weekends. We'll keep a simple calendar and a short checklist in the repo.
carlos: I'll create RDI-6010 (replay prompt corpus + verifier) assigned to me? or meera? Wait — meera owns the corpus, I'll create separate tickets: RDI-6010 -> replay corpus (meera), RDI-6011 -> CI gates + deploy scorecard (carlos), RDI-6012 -> monthly chaos + artillery scripts (carlos). Due dates: corpus Thu (2026-04-02), CI gates Tue (2026-04-07), chaos dry-run Fri (2026-04-10).
ops-bot: Created tasks RDI-6010 (replay corpus) assigned to meera, due 2026-04-02; RDI-6011 (ci gates + scorecard) assigned to carlos, due 2026-04-07; RDI-6012 (monthly chaos + artillery scripts) assigned to carlos, due 2026-04-10.
meera: I'll include the replay hash helper in the suite so triage can `replay --id repro:<sha1>` locally. Also adding a tiny tolerance table that lists acceptable token-distribution deltas per model family.
rowan: Nice. One more item: regression flakiness tracking. Can we add a short annotation in CI when a test fails with `flake:true` after 2 consecutive passes/failed toggles? That way we can deprioritize flaky inputs.
carlos: Yes — CI will label failing runs with `regression-needs-triage` and we will attach `repro:<sha1>` plus `flake:true` if flaky heuristics hit. We'll also auto-create a triage card linking the generated artifacts.
meera: Summary of owners/dates: meera -> replay corpus + verifier (due 2026-04-02), carlos -> CI gates + postdeploy scorecard (due 2026-04-07), carlos -> artillery chaos dry-run (due 2026-04-10), rowan -> publish regression-duty rota + triage checklist (due 2026-03-30). I'll drop the suite into `suites/regression/replay_fallback_hash.json`.
rowan: Thanks — please add the ticket links to RDI-4021 follow-ups when created. If any of these dates slip, comment in the ticket and @rowan so we can re-evaluate priorities. :white_check_mark:
